sentences.en: I'm sorry; I didn't mean to detract from what you were saying.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我不是想让你说的话失去影响力。

sentences.en: Further elaboration or ornament would only detract from the perfection of its simplicity.
sentences.zh: 进一步的阐述或装饰只会让它的简洁美大打折扣。

sentences.en: The scandal detracted from his reputation.
sentences.zh: 这个丑闻让他名声受损。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（向下）+tract（拉）→向下拉→去掉，减损
